#!/bin/sh

set -e

kopia --disable-file-logging repository connect filesystem --path /mnt/repository/repo-kopia
kopia --disable-file-logging cache set --content-cache-size-limit-mb 30000 --metadata-cache-size-limit-mb 20000 --cache-directory /cache
kopia --disable-file-logging --progress snapshot create /mnt/DS418 --fail-fast 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n'

sources:
  # host is the sending node's IP.
  talos:
    type: socket
    mode: tcp
    address: 0.0.0.0:6050
    decoding:
      codec: json
sinks:
  victoria_logs:
    type: http
    inputs:
      - talos
    uri: http://victoria-logs.observability.svc.cluster.local:9428/insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=host,talos-service&_msg_field=msg&_time_field=talos-time
    encoding:
      codec: json
      except_fields:
        - port
        - source_type
        - timestamp
    # Default for json is one JSON array per request; /insert/jsonline wants one object per line.
    framing:
      method: newline_delimited
    compression: gzip
